findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

On arrival the ice machine was observed with black slime/mold growth accumulation. The PIC was shown and cleaned the location during the inspection to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean at all times to prevent possible pathogenic growth/illness.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, ensure a certified food manager is present within facility during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer set up to be available upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was set up and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is set up during all hours of operations.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed no Certified Food Manager to be in facility upon inspection. PIC has documentation that the training was completed, however no documentation that the exam was taken and passed. Discussed with PIC, ensure 1 Certified Food Manager is present at all times of operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no soap to be available at the bar hand sink. Discussed with PIC, soap was replaced. Ensure all hand sinks are properly equipped to ensure proper hand washing. 

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no sanitizer solution to be set up during inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bottle was made and tested at 200 ppm(CL). Ensure sanitizer solution is set up at all times of operation. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed no bleach test strips to be present during inspection. Facility provided Quat test strips, however Quat is not being used as a sanitizer at the moment. Discussed with PIC, bleach test were given to facility by inspector. Ensure test strips are available at all times of operation to ensure sanitizing solutions are at the correct concentration. 

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Caulking is needed in the following areas: 3 compartment sink in back kitchen, mop sink in back kitchen, women’s hand sinks (all lack caulking from sink to wall).

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Observed the interior of the ice machine baffle to have a layer of pink, slime-y mold when a paper towel is run along the baffle edge. Discussed with PIC. Remove the ice from the machine and wash, rinse, sanitize the interior (particularly the baffle). 

Observed both soda guns at the bar to have mold. Discussed with PIC. PIC began to wash, rinse, sanitize the nozzles during the inspection. Ensure staff is aware to throughly clean the soda nozzles. A scrub may have to be used instead of just soaking the guns in sanitizer. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Caulking is needed in the following areas: 3 compartment sink in back kitchen, mop sink in back kitchen, women’s hand sinks (all lack caulking from sink to wall).
2. The board the microwave is sitting on within the kitchen needs to be painted or sealed with clear coat. The interior of the bar cabinets needs to be painted or sealed with clear coat.
3. There is a broken piece of trim on the cabinet in the men’s bathroom hand sink area. Repair the trim.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

On arrival, the test strips available for the sanitizer had gotten wet and were unusable.  A small amount were acquired during the inspection to correct. PIC instructed to ensure that usable test strips were available at all times. Inspector suggested maintaining a spare set in the office in case of emergency. PIC ordered multiple bottles during the inspection for future use.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
750.540 (C) Class II facilities are required to have a Certified Food Protection Manager at all times that foods are being handled or prepared. 

On arrival, there was not a CFPM at the facility. A CFPM arrived during the inspection to correct the violation. Both the CFPM that arrived and the PIC at inspector’s arrival did not seem aware of the requirement that the facility have one on site at all times of operation. Education took place and the PIC is instructed to ensure that a CFPM is on site at all times that food and food contact are handled.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (Pf) The Person in Charge shall ensure that: (O) “Food Employees and Conditional Employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as relate to disease that are transmissible through food as specified under 2-201.11 (A). 

No reporting agreements or other verifiable manner was observable during the inspection. A copy of the Sangamon County Reporting agreement was given to the PIC during the inspection. They are instructed to make copies and ensure that all Food Handlers have signed a copy. Follow up in 10 days.
